title: Five well earned stars..
text:
Five well earned stars... I love this little slicer. I was hesitant to purchase because of the price but I couldn't pass up the great deal and I'm happy that I did. The blades are sharp and it slices so easily and evenly. I've used it over 10 times in the last couple of weeks and I can see it lasting a long time.
Worth the purchase price.
